budget.rationale: The exact-date flight refresh moves the reconciled family band to $9,800–$12,650. The Budget 4/5 score follows the shared rubric; current airfare is an observed snapshot and must be re-priced before purchase.

weather.rationale: Official Faro 1991–2020 normals support warm, relatively dry June coast days. Exposed Sagres wind and midday heat require flexible timing but do not conflict with the route.

fireRisk.rationale: Moderate is the safety rating (3/5), corresponding to a 5–10% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. Portugal is one of Europe's highest absolute fire-danger countries and the official summer campaign begins June 1. Coastal Lagos is less exposed than the wooded interior, but Monchique, Sagres, and east–west road excursions add enough wildland interface that fire belongs in the plan.

swim.rationale: The week offers multiple meaningful beach or pool days, while official Algarve material places summer sea water near 20–22°C (68–72°F). The Atlantic is usable but cool; the lodging pool is the dependable warm-water fallback.

variety.rationale: The itinerary covers coast and water, towns and food, plus cliff and headland nature, but all seven nights remain in one region and nature is primarily coastal rather than a separate landscape mode.

ease.rationale: One lodging base, zero hotel moves, no rental car, no internal flight and no rail segment create the lowest deterministic load available for this European short-trip set. Only Faro transfers and one optional Sagres outing remain.

food.rationale: Lagos, Sagres and Praia da Luz days name current pizza, pasta, burger and grocery fallbacks. The apartment kitchen protects breakfasts and excursions, although the exact lodging and 2027 opening hours remain unconfirmed.

risk.rationale: Exact protected Faro inventory removes the former schedule gate. The remaining uncertainty is ordinary Atlantic/cliff conditions with flexible one-base fallbacks, supporting Risk 4/5.

nights.rationale: Seven hotel nights derive 1/5 under the comparison rubric for any trip of eight or fewer nights; this is expected for the separate short-trip category.

novelty.rationale: The Algarve, Lagos and Sagres do not overlap the documented visited-place list, so the novelty rubric derives 5/5.

pto.rationale: Four PTO days are better than the top documented six-day threshold and therefore receive 5/5; the observed Juneteenth holiday protects Friday June 18, subject to employer policy.
